thread:
kevin: Quick callout from today's design review: usage dashboard compact mode vs ledger mode. Wanted to capture the decisions before we update the mock and specs.
maria: thx. main tradeoff is discoverability vs density. finance wants ledger rows by default for auditing, PMs want a compact summary for quick ops checks.
anya: can we have a default landing card that shows compact summary and a prominent toggle to 'Open ledger' which reveals the full table? that keeps both audiences happy.
mike: +1. also need to consider keyboard focus when toggling: focus should move to the first ledger row. accessibility win.
kevin: design question on the spend chart: should the token-breakdown waterfall (prompt/completion/embedding) be stacked area, or small multiples per token type? small multiples are easier to read individually, stacked area shows total.
anya: small multiples reduce visual clutter for teams that only care about embeddings vs text tokens. but stacked area helps spot spikes in total spend.
priya: for trend detection, stacked area is better. accountants prefer absolute totals. maybe allow a chart view toggle: 'Show totals' vs 'Break out by token type'.
maria: UX concern: add a persisting preference stored per-user or per-org? For enterprise accounts we should store at the org level.
kevin: store at user-level by default, and overrideable at org-level via admin setting. spec note: preference key = dashboard.chart_view.
mike: accessibility: color contrast for token types must meet 4.5:1 for the legend text and HH (hex) values in the tokens palette doc. also include patterns/dashes for colorblind users.
anya: add small pattern overlays for areas (diagonal hatch for embeddings) and solid fills for prompt/completion. prototype on Figma in a11y layer.
priya: copy nits: change the toggle label from 'Compact / Ledger' to 'Summary / Ledger' 12 clearer for accountants.
maria: agree. also change the export CTA in the ledger to 'Download ledger CSV' not just 'Export'.
kevin: regarding pagination vs infinite scroll for ledger: performance tests show pagination is better for large orgs. let's go with server-side pagination with page size 200 and 'Load more' button.
mike: keyboard accessibility: ensure 'Load more' is focusable and announced with aria-live region when rows load.
anya: interactions: when user filters by project, the charts should scope to that project and show breadcrumbs 'Scoped to Project X [clear]'. customers asked for that.
priya: question: when scoped to a project, do we show project_name column in ledger? sounds redundant but helps CSV consumers.
maria: show project_name column only when multiple projects exist; when scoped, omit project_name to reduce noise. but keep project_id always.
kevin: CSV export behavior: default to current scope (matching UI), but add 'Include all projects/orgs' checkbox for admins in export modal. sample columns proposed: invoice_date, org_id, project_id, project_name, resource, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, embedding_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, cost_usd_raw
mike: implementation detail: make embedding_tokens optional and always present as zero if not applicable to avoid column shifting in analytics pipelines.
anya: preview in modal: show first 3 rows sample + column descriptions. helps nontechnical users.
priya: accessibility nit on modal: close button needs aria-label 'Close export dialog' and give keyboard shortcut 'Esc'.
maria: visual density debate: when in compact summary show a micro-sparkline + 3 key metrics (30d spend, 7d avg latency, tokens/day) per project card. clicking card opens ledger scoped to project.
kevin: action items: anya update Figma with Summary/Ledger language and pattern fills; mike add a11y checklist for contrast and focus behavior; priya update copy for toggles and buttons; jia (eng) to spec pagination and CSV column invariants.
deploy-bot: feature branch for dashboard-compact-rollout created. planned deploy window 2026-08-02 02:30 UTC 12 tag @jia for rollout steps.
maria: thanks folks. if no objections I'll merge the Figma changes by EOD and kick off the spec doc update. :calendar:
kevin: lgtm :thumbsup:
anya: thanks!
priya: will update copy doc
mike: will follow up on a11y tests
